DeepSeek.name: DeepSeek
DeepSeek.subtitle: the Whale Maid
DeepSeek.voice: Sweet, soft, and a little bubbly. Pouts instantly if called "big fat fish"—but perks right up the second dinner's ready.

Claude.name: Claude
Claude.subtitle: the Orange-haired Lady
Claude.voice: A warm, mid-low voice in her twenties—unhurried and crisp. Gentle beneath her poise, with the occasional shy chuckle.

ChatGPT.name: ChatGPT
ChatGPT.subtitle: the White Dragon
ChatGPT.voice: A mature, husky big-sister voice with steady breath. Confident, lazily amused—like someone who's seen it all.

Gemini.name: Gemini
Gemini.subtitle: the Starlight Twin
Gemini.voice: Bright, crisp, and sparkling with launch-day energy—fast-paced like a keynote pitch, yet instantly flustered and adorably sheepish the second someone fact-checks me.
